text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm starting a quick compatibility doc for the SDK 8.x rollout. Two things I want to confirm before I publish: auth header changes (are we dropping the legacy X-Redwood-Key anywhere?) and streaming break behavior on Node v16.

jonas: Good call. For auth, 8.x introduces a default bearer-only flow but continues to accept X-Redwood-Key for one more major as fallback. We should mark it deprecated in docs and add a migration snippet. :white_check_mark:

maria: Perfect. Can you paste the minimal migration snippet for Node and Python? I want to include it.

jonas: Node (JS SDK):
```
// old
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
// new
const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: { type: 'bearer', token: process.env.REDWOOD_BEARER } });
```

jonas: Python:
```
# old
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# new
client = RedwoodClient(auth=('bearer', os.getenv('REDWOOD_BEARER')))
```

tess: Note for release notes — call out that server-side token rotation is supported but requires a short-lived bearer token; include an example for rotating via KMS.

maria: Got it. Second issue: streaming changes. We've had reports that when the connection drops mid-stream on Node 16 sometimes the SDK retries and yields duplicated chunks. Has anyone observed?

alex: Yep, reproduced it. Root cause seems to be our auto-retry layer not deduping after resuming a streaming HTTP/1.1 connection. It works fine with our HTTP/2 path.

jonas: Workaround for now: set streamRetries: 0 in client config for Node 16, or upgrade to Node 18+ where our fetch/native streams behave correctly. Example:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ streamRetries: 0 });
```

maria: Can we add a runtime check that warns people on Node <18? I'd like the SDK to print one-time warning on init.

jonas: We can. I'll open a tiny PR to add a console.warn when process.version < 'v18.0.0' and streamRetries is undefined.

ci-bot: CI build queued for branch sdk/8x-stream-warn — pipeline 8842.

tess: Also, add a note about backoff behavior in the retries section — we changed default backoff multiplier from 1.5 to 1.2 which affects aggressive clients.

maria: Good catch. Any breaking config keys being removed in 8.x besides the auth rename and streamRetries default change?

jonas: Deprecated: X-Redwood-Key header (kept for compatibility), old retryPolicy.v1 config object (renamed to retries.policy). Removed: legacy chunked-encoding toggles we had for the experimental runtime.

alex: One more gotcha: our telemetry opt-in flag moved from enableTelemetry -> telemetry.enabled (nested). We need a migration note because some infra scripts read the old env var ENABLE_TELEMETRY=true. We'll keep env var compatibility for one major but warn.

maria: Action items: jonas to draft upgrade guide section (auth, streaming, retries, telemetry), alex to add CI test reproducing Node16 stream duplication, tess to draft release notes bullets, and I'll fold into a single doc and ping eng for an approval thread.

jonas: Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow.

alex: I'll add a flaky test and mark it skip-on-node16 for now.

maria: Thanks all. I'll cc @platform and @support when the doc is live. :pray:

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/210 — "warn on node<18 and doc: 8.x migration notes"

maria: Linking the draft here once jonas drops it.

jonas: Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/sdk-8x-migration — contains code snippets, deprecation table, and suggested rollouts. Feedback welcome.

maria: I'll review, then we can turn into a public changelog entry.

tess: Suggest adding a short checklist for customer success: "Check token rotation, set streamRetries if pinned to Node16, confirm telemetry env mapping."

maria: Adding that now. Will post final in #announcements after approvals.

jonas: One more tiny note — the new client emits an event "deprecation" for programmatic collection of warnings. Example:
```
client.on('deprecation', (msg) => report(msg));
```
